about.title: About JobConnect Rwanda
about.intro: JobConnect Rwanda is a digital platform that connects job seekers with individuals, small businesses, companies, organisations and event organisers offering local employment opportunities.
about.problemText: Information about local, part-time and short-term jobs is scattered across social media, WhatsApp groups, personal networks and many websites. Job seekers miss opportunities, and employers struggle to find people with the right skills quickly.
about.solutionText: One organised, trustworthy platform where employers post opportunities and job seekers search, apply and track their applications - with moderation that keeps scams and misleading listings out.
about.obj1: Centralise local job opportunities in Rwanda in a single, easy-to-search platform.
about.obj2: Help students, graduates, skilled workers and freelancers find work that matches their skills and location.
about.obj3: Give employers a simple tool to post jobs, review applicants and hire quickly.
about.obj4: Make the application process transparent with clear status tracking and notifications.
about.obj5: Protect users through reporting, moderation and employer verification.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information JobConnect Rwanda collects, how we use it and the choices you have. We process personal data in line with Rwanda's Law No. 058/2021 relating to the protection of personal data and privacy.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: Account details (name, email, phone, location and role), profile information you choose to add (skills, education, experience, professional summary, profile photo and CV), job postings and company details provided by employers, applications and cover letters, reports you submit, and technical information needed to keep the service secure (such as login times).

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: To create and secure your account, show job listings, send applications to the employers you choose, notify you about application updates, moderate content and prevent fraud, and improve the platform. We never sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Who can see your information
sections.body: Your public profile shows your name, location, skills, summary, education and experience. Your email, phone number and CV are only visible to you, to administrators, and to employers you have applied to. Employer company profiles and job postings are public.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: Passwords are stored as secure hashes, sessions use secure HTTP-only cookies, and CV downloads are restricted to authorised users. No online service is completely risk-free, so please use a strong, unique password.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can view and update your profile at any time, delete your CV, and permanently delete your account from your account settings. Deleting your account removes your profile, applications, saved jobs and notifications.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at {{email}}.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By creating an account or using JobConnect Rwanda you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: Using the platform
sections.body: You must provide accurate information and keep your login details confidential. You are responsible for activity on your account. Administrator accounts are created only by the platform operators.

sections.heading: Rules for employers
sections.body: Job postings must describe real opportunities honestly, including pay and requirements. Employers must not charge applicants any fee to apply or be hired, must not post discriminatory, illegal or misleading content, and may only use applicant data for recruitment.

sections.heading: Rules for job seekers
sections.body: Applications must be truthful. Do not submit files containing malware or content that belongs to someone else. Report suspicious jobs using the report button.

sections.heading: Moderation
sections.body: Administrators may review reports, remove jobs, and suspend or delete accounts that break these terms or put other users at risk.

sections.heading: No employment guarantee
sections.body: JobConnect Rwanda connects employers and job seekers but is not a party to any employment agreement and does not guarantee that a job or candidate will be found. Always verify an employer before sharing sensitive information or starting work.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
sections.body: We may update these terms; continued use of the platform means you accept the updated terms. Questions can be sent to {{email}}.
